reviews.review_text:
Ruby
Nantwich, United Kingdom8 contributions

The worst meal I have eaten in Vietnam so far- and I don’t often write reviews
Jun 2026 • Family
We ordered two pasta dishes- one being the German sausage penne, and the other being the Volcano pasta with beef tenderloin and we also had a portion of garlic bread. 

The German sausage penne was edible but not enjoyable. The sauce was the consistency of water, and it was entirely runny- you could tell it wasn’t freshly made, and the pasta was way over cooked (one of the more expensive pasta dishes on the menu).

The volcano pasta with beef tenderloin was awful. Given they advertise the dish as ‘beef tenderloin’ you would expect the beef to be tender and butter like. I can confirm that the cut used was definitely not tenderloin and it was incredibly cheap meat. The beef was chewy and incredibly fatty (90% of the meat was fat). 

As a result I only ate the sauce and pasta and left all the meat in the bowl as it was inedible, and then no waiter came out to clear our bowls, despite me having a conversation with a staff member telling them we had finished the meal. I told the waiter that I knew it wasn’t his fault, and that it was to do with the quality of the produce and he went to talk to who I believe was the manager. 

When we left the uncleared table, we asked for the bill which the manager gave me and I was shocked to see that I had still been charged full price for a meal that I had explained was completely poor, and I hadn’t eaten any of the expensive part of the meal (the beef). 

I said to the manager that I wasn’t willing to pay full price for a meal that was entirely disappointing and again explained that I understood it wasn’t the staff’s fault, but nor was it my own. He then told me that I had chosen to order that dish and so it was my fault. 

As someone who only ever complains if there is something very wrong with my meal, this frustrated me as the dish was falsely advertised as being beef tenderloin (fillet of beef) which it very clearly was not. He then told me he would do 20% off the price of my meal which I explained wasn’t sufficient as I only ate the cheap part of the meal. After a lot of backwards and forwards he agreed to discount 50% of the dish, which I thought was reasonable as I did eat the other components. 

I do have to say that the staff weren’t unpleasant, but they weren’t at all accommodating and given the other reviews I thought it was only fair to post about our experience.

A Grm in Nguyen Hue Walking Street
Jul 2025 • Family
We found this lovely restaurant hidden like a beautiful pearl in the sea of restaurants on Nguyen Hue Walking Street. It is not at street level but two floors up from the ground and believe me it's worth taking the stairs to get to it. The drinks were good, service great and the food amazing. This is truly a well located restaurant in the heart of the busyness, but, still out of reach for those who don't look up to see the beauty. We had a lovely meal and enjoyed this restaurant. I will highly recommend it and thanks to our waiter, Thong , for his inside information about Saigon
